verdict.rationale: Medusa's only documented MCP server is a docs-search server at docs.medusajs.com/mcp, which lets developers query documentation in their IDEs. It is not a store-side endpoint where shopping agents discover products or build carts. The pricing page mentions "Medusa MCP and Cloud CLI" with no detail, and nothing shows it serves storefront commerce to agents. The Store REST API and its OpenAPI spec are a developer building block, not a documented agent-commerce (MCP/UCP) endpoint, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a shopping agent can discover my store's products and build carts through a documented agent-commerce endpoint on the store (MCP/UCP), not by scraping
